description: Converts a color into code for 12 formats: HEX, HEX8, rgba(), hsla(), closest CSS named color, closest Tailwind class, SwiftUI Color, UIColor, Jetpack Compose, Android XML, Flutter, and React Native. Applies each platform's alpha byte order (RRGGBBAA on the web, AARRGGBB on Android/Compose/Flutter).

alpha.description: Opacity 0–1. Overrides any alpha embedded in the color input. Defaults to the input's alpha, or 1.

color.description: Color in any supported notation: hex (#F43, #FF6347, #FF6347CC), rgb()/rgba(), hsl()/hsla(), a CSS named color (tomato), or a Tailwind token (red-500).

name: convert_color
title: Convert Color
